## Elite Engineering Commands

### Essential Quality Gates
```bash
# Comprehensive testing
python scripts/execute-production-deployment.py

# Security validation
npm run security:scan
python -m bandit -r . -f json

# Performance validation
npm run performance:test
lighthouse --output json --output html

# Accessibility validation
axe --include-tags wcag2aa,wcag2aaa
pa11y --standard WCAG2AAA
```

### Cross-Workspace Coordination
```bash
# SDK integration validation
npm run sdk:validate
python scripts/validate-sdk-integration.py

# Configuration validation
python scripts/validate-config-schema.py
npm run config:test

# Documentation currency
npm run docs:generate
python scripts/sync-documentation.py
```
